products.title: Amber Bloom Set

products.title: Rivière Eternal Necklace
products.description:
Light, laid in a single row. This 40cm necklace is set with round brilliant cut clear cubic zirconia of about 3mm, each stone in its own four claw gold setting linked directly to the next so the line never breaks. A flat polished buckle station of about 12mm sits at the front. Wear it high on the neck with an open collar, or under a saree blouse for a wedding evening.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with an open collar shirt and small studs so the line stays uninterrupted.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 40cm
  • Stone: Round brilliant cut clear cubic zirconia, each in its own four claw setting
  • Setting: Individual four claw settings linked directly to one another
  • Feature: Flat rectangular buckle station, approximately 12mm, at the front
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Heartline Paperclip Necklace
products.description:

The plating is finished in 18k gold tone over surgical stainless steel, so it holds up to daily wear. Wear it on its own, or layer it under a longer chain.

products.title: Marquise Layering Set
products.description:
Two necklaces, made to be worn at once. The shorter one is a fine 1.2mm cable chain of about 40cm holding a single marquise cubic zirconia of roughly 10 x 5mm. The longer one is a Y-lariat scattered with 5mm marquise stations that falls just below it. Wear them together and the layering is already done for you, with no two clasps fighting at the back of the neck.

STYLING TIP: Wear both over a plain scoop neck so the single stone sits clear of the lariat's drop.

products.title: Baroque Pearl Lariat
products.description:
One long line, finished with a pearl. This lariat runs a fine 1.5mm gold snake chain through an open oval ring of about 20mm that holds a small round white shell pearl of about 6mm, with a large baroque shell pearl of about 15mm falling at the end. The slider lets you set how low the drop sits. Wear it long over a plain kurta for evenings out.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a deep neckline so the baroque pearl falls clear of the fabric.

Details

  • Chain: Fine snake chain, 1.5mm
  • Feature: Open oval gold ring, approximately 20mm across
  • Pearl: Small round white shell pearl, approximately 6mm, held in the ring
  • Drop: Large white baroque shell pearl, approximately 15mm
  • Style: Slider lariat with an adjustable drop
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated

products.title: Verdant Drop Earrings
products.description:
One stone of green, hung so it swings. Each earring drops about 25mm: a short curved bar at the lobe set with a line of tiny clear cubic zirconia, then a small jump ring, then a single cushion cut stone of about 9mm in a vivid mint turquoise green, held in four plain claws on a plain open basket. Nothing surrounds the stone, so the colour does all the work. Wear them with an open collar and the hair tucked behind the ear.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with hair tucked behind the ear and a cool toned outfit so the green reads clearly.

Details

  • Drop: Approximately 25mm from the lobe

  • Setting: Four plain claws on a plain open basket, with no halo around the stone
  • Top: Short curved bar set with a line of tiny clear cubic zirconia, carrying the ear post
  • Ear post: 925 sterling silver
  • Body: Copper alloy with cubic zirconia inlay, finished in silver tone
  • Sold as: One pair

Care

This piece is built on a copper alloy body with 925 sterling silver posts rather than the stainless steel used across the rest of the range, so give it a little more care. Keep it dry, take it off before swimming or bathing, keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe it with a soft dry cloth and store it in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Halo Curve Ring
products.description:
Two stones that do not match, and that is the point. This solid gold band of about 17mm inner diameter carries a natural tiger eye beside a faceted pale champagne crystal, each held in its own irregular bezel shaped to follow the stone rather than correct it. The tiger eye is opaque, banded brown and gold, with a soft moving sheen across it; the crystal beside it is clear and cut. The weight sits solidly across the finger. Wear it on its own, with the rest of the hand kept bare.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the index finger with bare hands so the two stones stay the whole story.

  • Setting: Irregular bezels shaped to each stone
  • Style: Statement cocktail ring
  • Weight: 4g
  • Plating: 18k PVD gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Amber Bloom Set
products.description:
Radiating warmth and elegance, this three-piece ensemble in a striking mustard yellow captures the perfect balance of tradition and modern finesse. The silk base lehenga is paired with a structured crop top adorned with delicate hand-embroidered butis, adding subtle shimmer to its clean silhouette. A flowing long jacket, richly detailed with intricate silver zari and sequin embroidery along the sleeves and borders, completes the look with effortless grace.

Lightweight yet statement-making, this set is designed for festive occasions, mehendi celebrations, or intimate weddings. Its versatile layering allows you to wear the jacket open for a contemporary appeal or draped for a regal presence.
• Handcrafted embroidery with zari and sequins
• Three-piece set: crop top, lehenga, and long jacket
• Ideal for day weddings, mehendi, and festive soirées
• Customisable in Swarovski and personalised stonework

products.title: Amber Radiance
products.description: A vibrant orange lehenga in silk-blend fabric, paired with a sleeveless blouse richly embroidered with mirror work, sequins, pearls, and glass beads. products.title: Rivière Eternal Necklace
products.description:
Light, laid in a single row. This 40cm necklace is set with round brilliant cut clear cubic zirconia of about 3mm, each stone in its own four claw gold setting linked directly to the next so the line never breaks. A flat polished buckle station of about 12mm sits at the front. Wear it high on the neck with an open collar, or under a saree blouse for a wedding evening.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with an open collar shirt and small studs so the line stays uninterrupted.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 40cm
  • Stone: Round brilliant cut clear cubic zirconia, each in its own four claw setting
  • Setting: Individual four claw settings linked directly to one another
  • Feature: Flat rectangular buckle station, approximately 12mm, at the front
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Verdant Drop Earrings
products.description:
One stone of green, hung so it swings. Each earring drops about 25mm: a short curved bar at the lobe set with a line of tiny clear cubic zirconia, then a small jump ring, then a single cushion cut stone of about 9mm in a vivid mint turquoise green, held in four plain claws on a plain open basket. Nothing surrounds the stone, so the colour does all the work. Wear them with an open collar and the hair tucked behind the ear.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with hair tucked behind the ear and a cool toned outfit so the green reads clearly.

Details

  • Drop: Approximately 25mm from the lobe
  • Stone: One cushion cut cubic zirconia in vivid mint turquoise green, approximately 9mm
  • Setting: Four plain claws on a plain open basket, with no halo around the stone
  • Top: Short curved bar set with a line of tiny clear cubic zirconia, carrying the ear post
  • Ear post: 925 sterling silver
  • Body: Copper alloy with cubic zirconia inlay, finished in silver tone
  • Sold as: One pair

Care

This piece is built on a copper alloy body with 925 sterling silver posts rather than the stainless steel used across the rest of the range, so give it a little more care. Keep it dry, take it off before swimming or bathing, keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe it with a soft dry cloth and store it in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Baroque Bloom Cuff
products.description:
Two different endings on one open circle. The cuff measures about 6cm by 5.5cm on 1.5mm wire, one terminal set with an irregular white mother of pearl slab of about 1.8cm by 0.7cm in a slim bezel, and the other a 1.7cm gold cap holding a clear emerald cut cubic zirconia. The white piece is polished shell, not a pearl. The open back slides on at the narrowest part of the wrist, making it an easy single statement for an evening out.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with sleeves pushed back so both terminals stay visible from every angle.

Details

  • Size: Open cuff, approximately 6cm by 5.5cm, on 1.5mm wire
  • Terminal one: Irregular white mother of pearl slab, approximately 1.8cm by 0.7cm, in a 0.25cm bezel
  • Terminal two: 1.7cm gold cap set with a clear emerald cut cubic zirconia
  • Shell: Mother of pearl is polished shell, not a pearl
  • Fit: Open back, slides on at the narrowest part of the wrist
  • Plating: 18k PVD gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Heartbead Bracelet

Two metals, but only just. The strand is built entirely from polished silver tone steel beads of about 6mm, mirror bright and strung in short runs joined by fine silver links, so the whole bracelet reads cool and quiet. The only warmth comes at the front, where a gold toggle bar and ring close it and a puffed gold heart of about 15mm hangs from the ring. Wear it on the days you want silver with one small gold note.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a silver tone watch so the gold heart stays the only warm thing on the wrist.

  • Links: Short runs of fine silver tone round links between the bead sections
  • Closure: Gold tone toggle bar and ring at the front
  • Charm: One puffed gold tone heart, approximately 15mm
  • Plating: Silver tone strand with 18k gold tone clasp and charm
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

products.title: Halo Curve Ring
products.description:
Two stones that do not match, and that is the point. This solid gold band of about 17mm inner diameter carries a natural tiger eye beside a faceted pale champagne crystal, each held in its own irregular bezel shaped to follow the stone rather than correct it. The tiger eye is opaque, banded brown and gold, with a soft moving sheen across it; the crystal beside it is clear and cut. The weight sits solidly across the finger. Wear it on its own, with the rest of the hand kept bare.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the index finger with bare hands so the two stones stay the whole story.

Details

  • Band: Solid gold band, inner diameter approximately 17mm, metal approximately 1.5mm

  • Stone two: Faceted pale champagne crystal
  • Setting: Irregular bezels shaped to each stone
  • Style: Statement cocktail ring
  • Weight: 4g
  • Plating: 18k PVD gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Petite Pavé Band

products.title: Halo Curve Ring
products.description:
Two stones that do not match, and that is the point. This solid gold band of about 17mm inner diameter carries a natural tiger eye beside a faceted pale champagne crystal, each held in its own irregular bezel shaped to follow the stone rather than correct it. The tiger eye is opaque, banded brown and gold, with a soft moving sheen across it; the crystal beside it is clear and cut. The weight sits solidly across the finger. Wear it on its own, with the rest of the hand kept bare.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the index finger with bare hands so the two stones stay the whole story.

Details

  • Band: Solid gold band, inner diameter approximately 17mm, metal approximately 1.5mm
  • Stone one: Natural tiger eye, opaque with chatoyant banding, approximately 11.8mm
  • Stone two: Faceted pale champagne crystal
  • Setting: Irregular bezels shaped to each stone
  • Style: Statement cocktail ring
  • Weight: 4g
  • Plating: 18k PVD gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

A fine open gallery sits beneath the setting so light passes through from below. Made in US size 7, it suits a proposal or a big evening out.

products.title: Pavé Dome Ring
products.description:
A dome that catches the whole room. The top of this open ring is a broad rounded dome about 16.8mm long and 15.7mm wide, pave set all over with small clear cubic zirconia and rising from a heavy tapered shank. The metal is rhodium plated over surgical stainless steel, and the open back gives a little room in the fit. Wear it as the only ring on the hand.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with bare nails and no other rings so the dome stands alone.

  • Weight: 4.5g
  • Plating: Rhodium plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

products.title: Halo Curve Ring
products.description:
Two stones that do not match, and that is the point. This solid gold band of about 17mm inner diameter carries a natural tiger eye beside a faceted pale champagne crystal, each held in its own irregular bezel shaped to follow the stone rather than correct it. The tiger eye is opaque, banded brown and gold, with a soft moving sheen across it; the crystal beside it is clear and cut. The weight sits solidly across the finger. Wear it on its own, with the rest of the hand kept bare.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the index finger with bare hands so the two stones stay the whole story.

Details

  • Band: Solid gold band, inner diameter approximately 17mm, metal approximately 1.5mm
  • Stone one: Natural tiger eye, opaque with chatoyant banding, approximately 11.8mm
  • Stone two: Faceted pale champagne crystal
  • Setting: Irregular bezels shaped to each stone
  • Style: Statement cocktail ring
  • Weight: 4g
  • Plating: 18k PVD gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

products.title: Blush Cluster Ring
products.description:
Soft pink, gathered into a flower. The front of this ring holds a round pink cubic zirconia of about 5mm at the centre, ringed by ten smaller pink stones of about 2.5mm, with one more set on the shoulder to one side. A slim round shank keeps the whole thing light on the finger. Made in a fixed US size 7, it is a gentle everyday ring with a little colour.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a soft neutral manicure so the pink cluster stays the brightest thing.

Details

  • Size: US 7, fixed size, not adjustable
  • Centre stone: Round pink cubic zirconia, approximately 5mm
  • Surround: Ten round pink cubic zirconia, approximately 2.5mm each
  • Detail: One further small pink stone set on the shoulder
  • Band: Slim round shank
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

The style is made in gold tone and silver tone plated finishes, and in several sizes, both confirmed at the time of order. Wear it as an everyday band that still has detail.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a slim stacking ring on the same finger for a soft everyday pair.

products.title: First Light Set
products.description:
A first piece of gold, and a quiet one. The set pairs a fine 1mm cable chain carrying a round clear cubic zirconia of about 5.8mm in a gold four prong setting with matching studs, each stud stone a little larger at about 7.3mm. The chain measures 42cm with a 5cm extender. Both pieces are 18k gold tone plated, so the finish stays consistent across the neck and ear. It is an easy gift, and an easier everyday default.

STYLING TIP: Layer it with a longer chain and keep the studs in for a soft everyday set.

Details

  • Set: Pendant necklace and matching stud pair
  • Chain: Fine cable chain, approximately 1mm, 42cm with a 5cm extender
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5.8mm on the pendant
  • Setting: Gold four prong
  • Studs: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7.3mm, included
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
